title: Repair Remote Desktop Commander autostart
description: User-approved repair. Discover RDC launch command, back up current scheduled-task evidence, create a delayed ONLOGON scheduled task with schtasks.exe, start RDC immediately, verify process and task. Do not delete unrelated data.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$evidence=$root+'/rdc-autostart-repair-evidence.txt';'=== RDC AUTOSTART REPAIR ==='|Set-Content $evidence;$npx=(Get-Command npx.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if(-not $npx){$npx=(Get-Command npx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source};if(-not $npx){throw 'NPX_NOT_FOUND'};$cmd='"'+$npx+'" -y @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander';('CMD='+$cmd)|Add-Content $evidence;$taskCmd='cmd.exe /d /c '+$cmd;cmd.exe /d /c ('schtasks /Create /TN "3EN-RemoteDesktopCommander-Autostart" /TR "'+$taskCmd.Replace('

')+'" /SC ONLOGON /DELAY 0000:45 /RL LIMITED /F') | Out-String | Add-Content $evidence;if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('SCHTASKS_CREATE_FAILED='+$LASTEXITCODE)};cmd.exe /d /c 'schtasks /Run /TN "3EN-RemoteDesktopCommander-Autostart"' | Out-String | Add-Content $evidence;Start-Sleep 12;Write-Host 'RDC_AUTOSTART_REPAIR_EXECUTED'
